name: Aaron Daniels
description: Joined the Merrick/Wangerin friend group mid-2015. Also had a crush on Liz Wangerin, adding a third angle to the 2015 dynamic. Appeared on the 2016 NYC class trip. Part of the 2019 friend group that dissolved after the Lala situation. Later married Lala.
public_footprint:
Founder and owner of Adept Detailing, a car detailing business in Potsdam and Plattsburgh, NY. Aaron J. Daniels of Potsdam earned an Associate in Applied Science in Civil Engineering Technology from SUNY Canton in spring 2019.
Sources: https://www.adeptdetailing.online/about-5; https://canton.meritpages.com/stories/Congratulations-Aaron-Daniels-for-earning-your-Associate-in-Applied-Science-at-SUNY-Canton-/15236344
